questions.q: I met Mary, ____ told me the news.
questions.zh: 我碰見瑪麗，她告訴我這個消息。
questions.explain: 【說明】主格關代 who 代替 Mary；但不可用 that，that 之前不能用「逗號」或「介系詞」。

questions.q: Our president is a man ____ everyone looks up to.
questions.zh: 我們的總統是受到每個人尊敬的人。
questions.explain: 【說明】whom 代替 man，作介系詞 to 的受詞。

questions.q: My father, ____ you met, is a merchant.
questions.zh: 我父親，你前天見過他，目前從商。
questions.explain: 【說明】whom 代替 father，作 met 的受詞。

questions.q: The girl ____ hair is blond comes from France.
questions.zh: 這位金黃色頭髮的女孩來自法國。
questions.explain: 【說明】whose ＋ 名詞 (hair)

questions.q: A child ____ parents are dead is called an orphan.
questions.zh: 雙親都去世的小孩叫做孤兒。
questions.explain: 【說明】whose ＋ 名詞

questions.q: He is the teacher ____ we all like.
questions.zh: 他是我們都喜歡的老師。
questions.explain: 【說明】whom 代替 teacher，作 like 的受詞。

questions.q: The man ____ was here just now is my uncle.
questions.zh: 剛才在這裡的人是我的叔叔。
questions.explain: 【說明】who 代替 the man，作 was 的主詞。

questions.q: Smoking, ____ is a bad habit, is nevertheless very popular.
questions.zh: 抽菸是一種壞習慣，但仍然很盛行。
questions.explain: 【說明】此為非限定用法，先行詞為 smoking，故用 which。

questions.q: There is nothing ____ can be done about it.
questions.zh: 那件事已無可奈何了。
questions.explain: 【說明】nothing, everything, anything 為先行詞，關係代名詞用 that。

questions.q: The car ran over a dog and a boy ____ just crossing the street.
questions.zh: 這輛車輾過了正在過街的小狗和男孩。
questions.explain: 【說明】先行詞（人和動物），必須用關係代名詞 that。

questions.q: All ____ I have done is wrong.
questions.zh: 我所做的一切都是錯的。
questions.explain: 【說明】all that ＝ what

questions.q: This is the longest train ____ I have ever seen.
questions.zh: 這是我所見過最長的一列火車。
questions.explain: 【說明】最高級的先行詞 (the longest train) 之後用 that。

questions.q: He didn't mean ____ he said.
questions.zh: 他言行不一致。
questions.explain: 【說明】沒有先行詞，關係代名詞用 what。

questions.q: I don't know ____ he is afraid of.
questions.zh: 我不知道他害怕什麼。
questions.explain: 【說明】沒有先行詞，關係代名詞用 what。

questions.q: Courtesy is to business ____ oil is to machinery.
questions.zh: 油之於機器正如禮貌之於生意一樣。
questions.explain: 【說明】A is to B what / as C is to D（A之於B猶如C之於D）

questions.q: ____ they wanted was to see the teacher, not the student.
questions.zh: 他們想要去看的是老師，而非學生。
questions.explain:
【說明】① 沒有先行詞，關係代名詞用 what。
② What they wanted 為名詞子句當主詞。

questions.q: I am glad to do ____ you want me to do.
questions.zh: 不論是何事情，你要我做我都樂意。
questions.explain: 【說明】此句沒有先行詞，故用複合關係代名詞 whatever。

questions.q: Give the dictionary to ____ wants it badly.
questions.zh: 把這本字典給極想要的人。
questions.explain: 【說明】此句沒有先行詞，故用複合關係代名詞 whoever（主格）+ wants...。

questions.q: Give the prize to ____ deserves it.
questions.zh: 把這個獎給應該得獎的人。
questions.explain: 【說明】此句沒有先行詞，所以用複合關係代名詞（主格）+ deserves...。

questions.q: You may give the prize to anyone ____ you think best.
questions.zh: 你可以把獎給任何一位你覺得最好的人。
questions.explain: 【說明】whom 代替 anyone，作 think 的受詞。

questions.q: On the bus I saw a student ____ I thought was your brother.
questions.zh: 在車上看見一位學生，我想他必是你的弟弟。
questions.explain: 【說明】I thought 為插入句，其後有動詞 was，因此前面應用主格 (who)。

questions.q: Tom is a man of his word, ____ I believe to be dependable.
questions.zh: 湯姆言而有信。我相信他是可靠之人。
questions.explain: 【說明】I believe 之後缺少受詞，故應用受格 (whom)。

questions.q: Is that the man ____ you are waiting?
questions.zh: 那一位就是你在等的人嗎？
questions.explain:
【說明】① whom + S + V，介系詞 for 可以放在 whom 之前。
② wait for（等待）

questions.q: We often come across people ____ we disagree.
questions.zh: 我們常會遇到意見與我們相左的人。
questions.explain: 【說明】disagree with（與…意見不一），介系詞 with 可移前而形成 with whom。

questions.q: This is the house ____ he used to live.（複選）
questions.zh: 這棟就是他住的房子。
questions.explain: 【說明】in which ＝ where（表示地方）

questions.q: China is the place ____ the silkworm was first discovered.
questions.zh: 中國是蠶首先被發現的地方。
questions.explain: 【說明】先行詞 (the place) 用關係副詞 where。

questions.q: He gave me more money ____ was required.
questions.zh: 他給我的錢比我所需要的還多。
questions.explain:
【說明】準關代 than 代替 money，其句型：
more ＋ 名詞 ＋ than ＋ (S) ＋ V

questions.q: Read only such books ____ you can understand.
questions.zh: 你只要讀你能了解的書就可以了。
questions.explain:
【說明】① such ＋ 名詞 ＋ as...（像…那樣的）
② as 為連詞兼作 understand 的受詞。

questions.q: There is no mother but ____ her children.
questions.zh: 沒有母親不愛自己的小孩。
questions.explain:
【說明】① There is no ＋ 名詞 ＋ but ＋ 動詞…（沒有…不…）
② but 為「否定的關係代名詞」，先行詞是 mother，故用 loves。

questions.q: There is no one in this world ____ loves good reputation.
questions.zh: 世上無人不愛好名聲。
questions.explain: 【說明】參考29題說明：There is no one... but loves...（無人不愛…）。

questions.q: Our parents and our teachers have made us ____.
questions.zh: 我們的雙親和師長們使我們有今天的成就。
questions.explain: 【說明】what ＋ 人 ＋ be（某人的成就／情況）

questions.q: I hope you will find this valley a beautiful place ____ you may spend your weekend.
questions.zh: 我想你會發覺這是座漂亮的山谷而在此外度週末。
questions.explain: 【說明】先行詞為 place，故用關係副詞 where。

questions.q: I know no such person ____ you have mentioned.
questions.zh: 我不認識像你所提到的人。
questions.explain:
【說明】such ～ as ＋ 不完整子句（像…的…）
such ～ that ＋ 完整子句（如此…以致…）

questions.q: The old gentleman never fails to help ____ is in need of his help.
questions.zh: 這老紳士從來沒有不幫助任何需要他幫助的人。
questions.explain: 【說明】沒有先行詞，用複合關代 ⇒ whoever ＝ anyone who

questions.q: Everybody had a good time at the party. There was not a person ____ laughed heartily.
questions.zh: 宴會中人人愉快，沒有人不盡情地笑。
questions.explain:
【說明】There was not a person who did not laugh.
＝ There was not a person but laughed.
＝ There was no person but laughed.

questions.q: The President Hotel, ____ I stayed last summer, is comfortable and the price is reasonable.
questions.zh: 去年夏天我住在總統大飯店，該飯店又舒適價錢又合理。
questions.explain: 【說明】關係副詞 where（表示地點）⇒ where ＝ at which

questions.q: The reason ____ I was feeling happy that morning was that the examination was over and we were going to have our long holidays.
questions.zh: 那天早上我覺得快樂是因為考試已經結束，而且我們將會有一個長假期。
questions.explain: 【說明】the reason why ＋ 子句 ＝ the reason for ＋ 受詞（表示原因或理由）。

questions.q: A theater is one of the places ____ is crowded with young people on holidays.
questions.zh: 戲院是假日擠滿年輕人的地方之一。
questions.explain: 【說明】空格之後有動詞 is crowded with，因此應選主格 which，不可用 where，因為 where 不可做主詞。

questions.q: A man's success doesn't lie in what he has ____ in what he is.
questions.zh: 一個人的成功不在於他的財富而在於他的人品。
questions.explain: 【說明】not lie in (A) but in (B)：不在於 A 而在於 B。

questions.q: As a matter of fact, he is not ____ as we think.
questions.zh: 事實上，他並不是我們想像中那樣誠實的人。
questions.explain: 【說明】such... as ＋ S ＋ V（像…那樣的）

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 依中文提示在空格中填入適當的字詞

questions.q:
今日事，今日畢。
Never ____ ____ till tomorrow ____ you can do today.
questions.zh: 今日事，今日畢。
questions.explain: 【說明】put off ＝ postpone（延期）

questions.q:
閃爍者未必全是金。
____ ____ glitters is not gold.
questions.zh: 閃爍者未必全是金。
questions.explain:
【說明】All... not... ＝ Not all...（未必所有的…都是…）
例：All men can't succeed in life. ＝ Not all men can succeed in life.（未必所有的人都能在人生中獲得成功。）

questions.q:
人人皆會犯錯。
There is no one ____ ____ his own faults.
questions.zh: 人人皆會犯錯。
questions.explain: 【說明】There is no ＋ 名詞 ＋ but ＋ V 表示「雙重否定」。（無一…而不；每…必定）

questions.q:
他不可靠，因為他言行不一。
He is not reliable because he doesn't mean ____ ____ ____.
questions.zh: 他不可靠，因為他言行不一。
questions.explain:
【說明】① what he says 指「他所說的話」
② what he is 指「他的人品」
③ what he has 指「他的財富」

questions.q:
不論發生什麼事，我都會支持你。
____ ____ happens, I will ____ by you.
questions.zh: 不論發生什麼事，我都會支持你。
questions.explain:
【說明】① no matter what ＝ whatever（不論什麼）
② stand by ＝ support（支持）

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成英文

questions.q: 誠實友善的人是值得我們尊敬的。
questions.hint: 值得我們尊敬的：be worth one's while to + V
questions.answer: It is worth while respecting people who are honest and friendly.
questions.zh: 誠實友善的人是值得我們尊敬的。
questions.explain:
【說明】① It is worth while ＋ V-ing
例：It is worth while seeing the museum. (○)
It is worth seeing the museum. (×)
② 物 is worth ＋ V-ing
例：The museum is worth seeing. (○)
The museum is worth while seeing. (×)
③ It is worth one's while to ＋ V

questions.q: 但是自私驕傲的人是不值得我們交往的。
questions.hint: 自私驕傲的人：those who are selfish and arrogant
questions.answer: But it isn't worth our while to associate with selfish and arrogant people.
questions.zh: 但是自私驕傲的人是不值得我們交往的。
questions.explain:
【說明】① associate with（與…交往）
② arrogant 形（傲慢的、驕傲的）

questions.q: 正如選好書一般，我們應選擇可靠的朋友。
questions.hint: ①正如：just as + S + V ②可靠的：dependable, reliable
questions.answer: (Just) as we choose good books, so should we choose reliable friends.
questions.zh: 正如選好書一般，我們應選擇可靠的朋友。
questions.explain:
【說明】As..., so...「正如…，…也一樣」
例：As you sow, so shall you reap.（一分耕耘，一分收穫。）

questions.q: 否則，我們可能會身敗名裂，這是無可彌補的損失。
questions.hint: ①身敗名裂：be ruined ②無可彌補的：can't make up for
questions.answer: Otherwise, we are likely to have our career ruined which can't be made up for.
questions.zh: 否則，我們可能會身敗名裂，這是無可彌補的損失。
questions.explain:
【說明】「身敗名裂」可用下列各種表達：
disgrace oneself / lose one's good name / bring discredit on oneself / suffer a personal defeat

questions.q: 朋友與我們有密切的關係，選擇朋友應越小心越好。
questions.hint: 應越小心越好：can't be too careful
questions.answer: Friends have a close connection with us and we can't be too careful in choosing them.
questions.zh: 朋友與我們有密切的關係，選擇朋友應越小心越好。
questions.explain:
【說明】「再…也不為過／越…越好」
① S ＋ cannot be ＋ too ＋ 形容詞
② S ＋ cannot ＋ 原形 V... too much
例：We cannot be too careful in choosing a career.（我們選擇職業時越小心越好。）
例：We cannot concentrate on our studies too much.（我們越專心於課業越好。）

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions: 閱讀下列短文，選出最適當的答案填入各題空格中
sections.passage: __1__ the world today, advertising helps __2__ more things to more people. This __3__ makes it possible to produce more things to sell. __4__ some times it even helps make things __5__ less. Radios, __6__, used to cost much more than they __7__ today because they were turned __8__ slowly and expensively by hand. But advertising made more people want radios. __9__ advertising starts us buying and producing more things, it is sometimes __10__ the "spark plug" of the business world.
vocabulary_notes: 2. makes it possible to: 使…成為可能
8. spark plug: 火星塞（火花塞）

questions.q: ____ the world today, advertising helps sell more things to more people.
questions.zh: 在今日世界，廣告幫助把更多東西賣給更多人。
questions.explain: In the world today（在今日世界）

questions.q: ...advertising helps ____ more things to more people.
questions.zh: 廣告幫助把更多東西賣給更多人。
questions.explain: help ＋ 原形動詞（有助於…）

questions.q: This ____ makes it possible to produce more things to sell.
questions.zh: 這反過來使生產更多可銷售的產品成為可能。
questions.explain: in turn（輪流地；依次地；反過來）；take turns（輪流）

questions.q: ____ some times it even helps make things cost less.
questions.zh: 有時它甚至有助於降低物品成本。
questions.explain: At times（在某些時候；有時）

questions.q: ...it even helps make things ____ less.
questions.zh: 它甚至有助於使物品花費更少。
questions.explain: 「東西花費多少錢」用 cost。

questions.q: Radios, ____, used to cost much more than they do today...
questions.zh: 舉例來說，收音機過去的價格比現在昂貴許多…
questions.explain: for example（比如說；舉例而言）；in short（總之）

questions.q: ...used to cost much more than they ____ today...
questions.zh: 比現在所花費的昂貴許多…
questions.explain: 助動詞 do 代替前面提過的一般動詞 cost。

questions.q: ...because they were turned ____ slowly and expensively by hand.
questions.zh: 因為它們以前是用手工緩慢且昂貴地製造出來的。
questions.explain: turn down（拒絕）；turn out（生產；製造）；turn over（移交）；turn into（轉變成）

questions.q: ____ advertising starts us buying and producing more things, it is sometimes called...
questions.zh: 因為廣告帶動我們購買和生產更多的物品…
questions.explain: Because（因為），Therefore（因此），Although（雖然），Moreover（而且）

questions.q: ...it is sometimes ____ the "spark plug" of the business world.
questions.zh: 它有時被稱為商業界的「火星塞」。
questions.explain: it is sometimes called...（有時被稱為…），被動語態用過去分詞 called。
